method: Read-only aggregate SQL against production public tables; no member IDs, names, phones, order IDs, or item keys were exported.
evidence_limits: The current-state query verifies the post-sync contents but cannot independently reconstruct the before/after states of Claude's rerun.
The reported same-day rerun proves conflict-upsert repeatability for an unchanged result set; it does not prove deletion-safe reconciliation when the source later removes a row.
The current table has no source_system_id, location_id, ingest batch, raw-row evidence, foreign keys, or batch completeness manifest.
member_id is a cached attribution result; the target model rebuilds attribution from member-card transaction facts and retains ambiguous/unmatched status.
